tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Alternative hypotheses for the weak maximum principle] 1. ch8:8.1\group ch08-generalized-solutions In Theorem 8.1, when $u\leq 0$ on $\partial \Omega $, condition (8.8) may be replaced by either \begin{equation} \int _\Omega (dv+c^iD_iv)\, dx\leq 0 \qquad \forall v\geq 0,\quad v\in C_0^1(\Omega ), \tag {8.99} \end{equation} or the almost-everywhere block-matrix condition \begin{equation} \begin{bmatrix} a & b \\ -c & -d \end{bmatrix}\geq 0. \tag {8.100} \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch For (8.99), use the adjoint form of the truncation computation. Under (8.100), the combined principal, first-order, and zeroth-order terms in that computation form a nonnegative quadratic expression.

□
